opening.argument: The presentation directly solicits participation in BitConnect by offering daily interest and directing viewers to the description link to join. It lays out the investment process: deposit at least $100 in Bitcoin, exchange it for BitConnect coins, and lend those coins in connection with projected profits and promised return of principal. The displayed interest figures and earnings calculator reinforce that solicitation by presenting potential returns. These features establish a scam investment promotion built around lending returns. The available evidence does not establish that the projected figures were fulfilled or that funds were transferred; the case rests on the solicitation and its return claims.
